definitions.phase: SL3 labels (outputs/verify/SL3/scores/series.json; MuJoCo gripper-target contact and lift z0+10 mm); post_release 0 calls; carry = grasp + transport
definitions.visible_gt_sample: |recorded depth - sample camera z| <= 10 mm in head or left_wrist (GT samples: visual geoms, 4 mm, cap 3000/instance, seed 0)
definitions.precision: fraction of ATS target points with exact distance to the GT target (akita_black_bowl_1) visual surface <= 10 mm
definitions.recall: fraction of visible GT target samples with an ATS target point within 10 mm
definitions.centroid_err_vis_mm: |ATS target centroid - centroid of visible GT target samples|
definitions.occupied: ESDF value <= 5 mm (also 20 mm); erased = occupied in main and > 5 mm in target-free
definitions.field_err: ESDF(sphere centre) - exact distance to visual surfaces of instances (mount excluded; tf: target also excluded), spheres with exact <= 0.4 m and centre not inside a collision primitive; 22 gripper constraint spheres
definitions.offline_harness: phase flag approach, active left, no execution_path (window from q_now), no grasp latch/attach: the carried bowl stays an unheld target after grasp

profile_config_diff.reason: RB-Y1 link names (ee_left/ee_finger_l1/l2, ee_right/...) do not exist on the Panda; the single Panda arm is the left manipulator (SL2) and its contact-authorized links are the palm + both fingers (PANDA_CONTACT_LINKS, the Panda analogue of DEFAULT_CONTACT_LINKS)

z only: V11AB default_bounds() floor is base z 0.0 (RB-Y1 table well above its base); the LIBERO table top is at base z -0.012 m (SL1 verify), so the default box cuts the table out of the field. Floor lowered to -0.1 m; x/y unchanged

constructor_differences.reason: robot geometry; same link group name (SL2 link-set table)
the palm a held object attaches to (T32 H2), Panda link name
RB-Y1 capsule-thinning knobs; franka.yml spheres are zero-length role-collision capsules, a 0.05 radius scale would shrink them to 5 % (SL2 impl)
RB-Y1 finger-body cover (gripper_cover.finger_body_capsules); the Panda fingers keep their franka.yml spheres (SL2)

constructor_differences.what: contact links read by the start-up log
constructor_differences.reason: log only in build_ag3s; the config row is the decision

n4_wrist_mirror.attention_mass_split_definition: outputs/verify/SL4/attention_split.json (mean over calls; mass_other = 1 - target - destination - gripper; mass_arm and mass_rest are parts of other)

numbers.exact_distance_check: analysis distance (KD-pruned exact point-triangle) equal to SceneGT.exact_distance brute force: max abs diff 0.0 (300 random points) and identical per-call #2/#8 numbers on t0 (outputs/verify/SL4/logs/test_distance.log, analyze_bruteforce_check.log)

verdict: 기준선 일치 (legacy, cuRobo 둘 다). core diff 0줄. profile config 차이 = contact.contact_links, esdf.bounds_lower (z) (v11ab box: contact.contact_links). CPU regression A 73 passed / B 92 passed / C 90 passed 2 skipped, exit 0. SL0 flags-off replay npz all keys equal.
not_measured: attach / held-object path after grasp (offline harness has no grasp latch; carry-phase numbers are for an unheld target)
init states 1-4 (only init 0 dev data exists for SL3 attention)
ESDF value at mount-residual cloud points themselves (only at mount GT samples within 10 mm of them)
